# Evoke Creative Creations

> Independent design studio led by Rameez Ahmed. AI supports research; Rameez leads visual design and final review. Services include brand identity, logo design, social media graphics and Roblox UI.

## Studio and enquiries

- [Home](https://evokecreativecreations.com/): Studio introduction and selected work.
- [Studio](https://evokecreativecreations.com/about): Background and design practice.
- [Services](https://evokecreativecreations.com/services): Overview of available design services.
- [Pricing & Packages](https://evokecreativecreations.com/pricing): Compare starting prices, included deliverables, revision scope and custom quotation.
- [Contact](https://evokecreativecreations.com/contact): Discuss project requirements and request a quote.

## Dedicated services

- [Logo Design](https://evokecreativecreations.com/services/logo-design): Focused logo packages from $250 USD; confirm the deliverables and final quote before booking.
- [Social Media Design](https://evokecreativecreations.com/services/social-media-design): Three static posts for one platform from $150 USD; covers and larger campaigns are scoped separately.

- [Roblox UI Design](https://evokecreativecreations.com/services/roblox-ui-design): Interface design for Roblox games.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://evokecreativecreations.com/services/brand-identity-design): Visual identity design for businesses.
